metadata.title: Kelverion.Azure.DevOps
metadata.description: This Integration Module provides cmdlets for automating interaction with Azure DevOps and is designed to be used with Runbook Studio and Azure Automation. Take the Runbook Studio for a test drive on the Azure Marketplace (http://bit.ly/AzureRBS) or get more information and download from (https://www.kelverion.com/runbook-studio/). For a free evaluation licence please email info@kelverion.com.
